options.text: Fastest at 70, because hotter is always faster for a catalyst.
Fastest near 37. At 70 it unfolds, the pocket is gone, and it stops for good.
The same at every temperature, because enzymes are shaped, not heated.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Shape does not care about heat."

image.alt: A folded enzyme protein shown at five temperatures, cool and slow, warm and fast, then hot and unravelling.
